## Details

<a id="BP-001"></a>
### BP-001 — Leave request and approval

**Objective:** Take an employee's leave request from submission to a final decision, consistently and by the end of the month of the leave start date.

**Steps:**

| ID | Name | Actor |
|---|---|---|
| BP-001-S01 | Employee submits a leave request: leave type, dates with day part (All day, Morning, Afternoon), the confirming Project Manager and any required documents | [Employee](actors.view.md#ACT-001) |
| BP-001-S02 | System blocks a request with dates outside the allowed window, a missing required document or an ineligible leave type; it accepts a request that exceeds the entitlement, flags it for manual review, and emails the selected Project Manager |  |
| BP-001-S03 | Selected Project Manager confirms or denies the request. The step is auto-confirmed when the requester is a Project Manager and skipped when the employee belongs to no project. Confirmation emails the Line Manager; denial emails the employee | [Project Manager](actors.view.md#ACT-002) |
| BP-001-S04 | Line Manager approves or rejects the request. The employee is emailed | [Line Manager](actors.view.md#ACT-003) |
| BP-001-S05 | After a denial or rejection, the employee may modify and resubmit the request | [Employee](actors.view.md#ACT-001) |
| BP-001-S06 | Until the Line Manager has approved it, the employee may cancel the request | [Employee](actors.view.md#ACT-001) |
| BP-001-S07 | When the month of the leave start date ends, the system cancels a request that is still not confirmed or approved | [System Scheduler](actors.view.md#ACT-006) |

<a id="BP-002"></a>
### BP-002 — Annual leave entitlement refresh

**Objective:** Give every employee the correct leave entitlements for the new year.

**Steps:**

| ID | Name | Actor |
|---|---|---|
| BP-002-S01 | System starts the annual refresh automatically at the start of the year | [System Scheduler](actors.view.md#ACT-006) |
| BP-002-S02 | System calculates each employee's entitlements for the new year: base days plus one day per N years of service, for the leave types the employee is eligible for | [System Scheduler](actors.view.md#ACT-006) |
| BP-002-S03 | System checks the requests still pending against the new entitlements | [System Scheduler](actors.view.md#ACT-006) |

<a id="BP-003"></a>
### BP-003 — Leave type and policy administration

**Objective:** Keep leave types, their eligibility rules and documentation requirements in line with company policy and regulations.

**Steps:**

| ID | Name | Actor |
|---|---|---|
| BP-003-S01 | Admin/HR creates or edits a leave type | [Admin/HR](actors.view.md#ACT-004) |
| BP-003-S02 | Admin/HR sets its eligibility rule (gender) and its entitlement rule (base days, and N years of service per extra day) | [Admin/HR](actors.view.md#ACT-004) |
| BP-003-S03 | Admin/HR sets its required documentation | [Admin/HR](actors.view.md#ACT-004) |

<a id="BP-004"></a>
### BP-004 — Weekly attendance compliance notification

**Objective:** Make absence without approved leave visible to employees every week.

**Steps:**

| ID | Name | Actor |
|---|---|---|
| BP-004-S01 | System fetches check-in and check-out data from the card scanner system | [Card Scanner System](actors.view.md#ACT-005) |
| BP-004-S02 | System determines each employee's off-work days among the working days of the last week | [System Scheduler](actors.view.md#ACT-006) |
| BP-004-S03 | System matches off-work days against the employee's leave requests; any submitted request counts | [System Scheduler](actors.view.md#ACT-006) |
| BP-004-S04 | System notifies the employee of absent days without a leave request and absent days with a valid leave request | [System Scheduler](actors.view.md#ACT-006) |

<a id="BP-005"></a>
### BP-005 — Leave reporting

**Objective:** Give HR and Line Managers visibility of leave usage.

**Steps:**

| ID | Name | Actor |
|---|---|---|
| BP-005-S01 | User opens the reporting screen | [Admin/HR](actors.view.md#ACT-004) |
| BP-005-S02 | User chooses the level: unit, department or entire company. A Line Manager is limited to their own unit | [Admin/HR](actors.view.md#ACT-004) |
| BP-005-S03 | System shows leave usage statistics for that level |  |
